business.description: Dhunseri Ventures Limited is a holding and investment company with income from trading activities, investments, royalty, and dividends from joint ventures. It operates through wholly-owned subsidiaries in infrastructure and BOPET/BOPP film manufacturing, and holds 50% stakes in two joint ventures with Indorama group for petrochemical and polyester production.

outlook.statement: DPFPL's BOPP Film Line at Jammu has substantial competitive advantage positioning it favourably for long-term growth and profitability, though it may take time to witness significant improvement in market conditions.

Group is actively evaluating various alternatives for optimal utilization of developed space at Dhunseri Commercial Park, including possibility of de-notification of area under SEZ regulations for broader commercial purposes.

Twelve Cupcakes Pte. Ltd. liquidation process continued under supervision of appointed liquidators; Board approved proposed liquidation including sale/transfer/disposal of shareholding/assets, subject to shareholder approval.

DPFPL's project in Jammu is progressing largely as per the plan, although there was some temporary disruption of activities due to geo-political situation, however, now the project activities have restarted. Management is targeting to start its operation of first line of BOPP production tentatively from August/September 2026, while second line is expected to start its operation from the first quarter of 2027.
The New BOPET line is expected to commence commercial production in April, 2028.

It is a challenging business and it may take some time to witness a significant improvement in market conditions. However, its BOPP Film Line at Jammu has a substantial competitive advantage thereby positioning it favourably for long-term growth and profitability.

The Management has to regularly monitor the changing market conditions and the trends. Further, any slowdown of the economic growth or volatility in the financial market could also adversely affect the Company's performance.

The Group is actively evaluating various alternatives for optimal utilization of the developed space, including the possibility of obtaining de-notification of the area under the applicable SEZ regulations for a broader range of commercial and other permissible purposes.

The Group has estimated and accounted for incremental liability pertaining to employee benefit obligations due to new Labour Codes, which is not material to the consolidated financial results. The Group continues to monitor developments pertaining to enactment of these Labour Codes and evaluate impact, if any.

The Company has taken various initiatives to maintain its leadership, improve market share and financial performance. It has been aggressively pursuing and implementing its strategies to improve financial performance.
